changes.comment: BREAKING: Custom ClaudeCodeSessionFactory implementations must replace submitTurn/steerTurn with submit returning RuntimeAdmission and per-request settlement. Session specs now provide sessionId and optional outputSchemaEnabled; exit handlers receive an Error, and protocol callbacks observe results and interrupted boundaries rather than performing settlement. Remove request-window coordination, retain native background work, and settle folded or queued inputs directly. Core and neutral runtime contracts are unchanged.
